title: Log Severity Aggregator
statement:
A cloud server generates structured log lines in the format: [TIMESTAMP] [SEVERITY] MESSAGE. Severity levels are INFO, WARN, ERROR, and FATAL.

Parse the logs and output the total count for each severity level in the exact format: INFO: X, WARN: Y, ERROR: Z, FATAL: W.
input_format: The first line contains an integer N. The next N lines each contain a log line.
output_format: Output a single line: INFO: X, WARN: Y, ERROR: Z, FATAL: W
sample_input:
4
[2026-11-17 10:00:01] [INFO] Server started
[2026-11-17 10:00:02] [WARN] Memory high
[2026-11-17 10:00:03] [ERROR] Connection timeout
[2026-11-17 10:00:04] [INFO] Client disconnected
